notes:
Remote ID now broadcasts the takeoff point as the operator location.

The position sent was the controller's own, labelled as the aircraft's
takeoff spot — two different things under one field. It now sends the
takeoff point itself, stated as such, and falls back to the controller's
live fix (declared as live GNSS) until the aircraft has armed. Nothing
waits on it, so a launch is never held up for want of an operator fix.
